question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01';

params.output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01';

question: List the top 5 products by total revenue last month.
schema_ref: orders(id, product_id, amount, created_at), products(id, name)
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month') AND o.created_at < date_trunc('month', current_date) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

params.output: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which countries have more than 1000 customers?
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000;

params.output: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000;
